<a id="first_star_logo_r19_right"></a>
### [`first_star_logo_r19_right`](../../../../src/data/first_star_logo.asm#L6) `$68E8-$69A7`

*data*

First Star Software logo in multicolour bitmap cells of 8 bytes. The init copies it to bitmap rows 19-24 at $37c0-$3f3f.
Row 19, columns 16-39: 24 cells, copied to $3840. The title shows bitmap rows 19-24 from raster line $ca.

- **Read by:** [`init_screens`](../init/init_screens.md#init_screens) [`$8D62`](../../../../src/init/init_screens.asm#L53)
